ZIGZAG Acquisition
ZIGZAG was acquired by Kakao for $900M on 15 April 2021.
The acquisition price implies a 25.7x revenue multiple on $35M of revenue.
Before the acquisition ZIGZAG had raised $9M across 2 funding rounds.

This acquisition fits Kakao's e-commerce diversification strategy amid South Korea's booming online retail sector, following its decision not to bid for eBay Korea and amid competition from players like SSG.com, which acquired W Concept. The merger is expected to leverage synergies for enhanced mobile shopping across demographics.
